entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to start a return. Order number is VF-881-945.

Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was for the Aero Pro Jersey. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with it?
I see. Is it a technical fault with the material, or a preference issue with the fit?
It's just too tight. I need to get a bigger one. Can I do an exchange or not?

Yes, absolutely. I see the delivery was 22 days ago. Since the jersey is a standard item, it's well within our 90-day return policy. We can definitely process that exchange for a different size for you.
Great. That's what I needed to know. What's the next step?

I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid return label. Just pack the original jersey back in its packaging, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see the return has been scanned, we'll ship out the new size.
Okay, got the email. Looks good. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
